content.text:
The Run panel's content now sits 16 pixels in from every edge, top included, in all three views. The spec builds and the six Run panel tests pass, but I haven't looked at it in the running app.

- **Finding how to run:** the harness output table had no top padding at all, so its header sat right against the line under "Looking at the project". It now starts 16 pixels below it, and its bottom padding went from 12 to 16.
- **Console output:** a running target's output had only 8 pixels above the first line and below the last. It now has 16 above and below, matching the 16 at the sides.
- **Targets found:** this view already had 16 pixels all round.

**Changes:**
- **Spec:** a line in the panel overview of `spec/scope/run-targets/index.pi` says the body is inset 16 pixels on every side.
- **Code:** in `src/run_view.rs`, all three views now use one shared 16-pixel setting (`BODY_INSET`), so they can't drift apart again.
